SPY.title: The S&P 500 Recently Hit Another Record High. Should You Wait Until the New Year to Invest in It?
SPY.description: The S&P 500 has hit a new all-time high, leading some to hesitate about investing. However, the article advises against trying to time the market and instead recommends using dollar-cost averaging to invest in the S&P 500 consistently over time.
SPY.author: Stefon Walters

SPY.title: All Eyes On December Fed Meeting As Traders Await Interest Rate Projections
SPY.description: The Federal Reserve is expected to cut interest rates by 0.25% at its December meeting, bringing the federal funds rate to 4.25%-4.50%. Traders are more focused on the Fed's updated economic projections and guidance, which could reshape expectations for 2025 rate cuts.
SPY.author: Piero Cingari
